# Atlas

> Atlas is a governed AI customer-operations platform for service businesses.

## What Atlas is
Atlas brings customer conversations, CRM, lead follow-up, service workflows, automation, AI agents, approvals and operational evidence into one tenant-scoped workspace.

## Core capabilities
- Customer relationship management and pipeline workflows
- Unified conversation and service operations
- Governed AI agents and human handoff
- Workflow automation with approvals, retries and execution evidence
- Website/funnel and SEO publishing contracts
- Billing, provider and integration governance

## Trust boundary
Atlas does not claim a provider, model, payment account, public website, or infrastructure service is live merely because its source contract exists. Production activation requires verified credentials, deployment evidence and successful operational checks.

## Primary website
Use the canonical Atlas website and its linked documentation for current product information.
